text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday wasn't feeling well,
so I had her rest in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~...☆
I'll get plenty of rest and become marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Seekers of the "Legendary Maple Syrup."
What you desire lies beyond this bridge.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Legendary maple syrup!?
What's that? I sense something super marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't just let you through that easily, though!
"Do not cross this bridge"—
Solve this riddle before you may proceed!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ! What, that's super easy☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Lend me your streeength!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: !? Wh... What is that glowing silver object?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
――♪☆★ (Please!)
――――――!! (Carry us across the bridge!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! With this, it'll be a breeze!
Marvelouuus☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
☆?★☆! (Almost time!)
~~--★☆★♪! (Drop me off around here!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Tohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really an Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Take it.
I've lost all will to protect it from you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you! That over there
must be the legendary maple syrup☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I know this scent...
Is it the syrup Grandma used to make...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it--!
Amazing, incredible, it's overflowing☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is it, this refreshing sweetness!
Ehehe~~, that timeless taste is marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
That was so fun and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have had a wonderful dream.
Upon waking up, Marvelous Sunday seemed
to have regained her usual high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Grandma... I wonder when I'll get to see you next?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice~ Grandma's pancakes.
I wanna eat some too~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Marvelous Sunday couldn't get back
into top form due to loneliness...
